But once there, she uncovers sinister family secrets and is lured into a desperate and terrifying scavenger hunt where every find pulls her deeper into an inescapable nightmare.

results.overview: Lisa witnesses a mysterious man leave an envelope on a bridge, soon picked up by a woman. The next day the story repeats, but the woman doesn't show. Instead Lisa takes the envelope and embarks on a Kafkaesque quest between time and space.

results.title: Lotgenoten

results.title: Behind
results.overview: A global butt-dial outbreak sweeps the planet, leaving the real horror still to come.

results.title: East Did Meet West
results.overview: Inspired by the 1930s court case Roldan vs. Los Angeles County, Filipino Salvador  Roldan and English Marjorie Rogers must find a way to convince an attorney to fight  for their marriage despite the anti-miscegenation laws of the time.
